verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. An integrated document-editing workspace with autosave is an end-user application feature, so this story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows vLLM ships any document workspace; its OpenAI-compatible server, tool calling and structured outputs are serving primitives, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
